_comment: Autonomy and safety switches. Everything that touches the outside world is OFF by default and can only be enabled by a human editing this file.

campaign.objective: Acquire one golf cart evaluation/demo unit at $0 landed cost.

home_market._comment: metro_cities: nearby city names that count as pickup-distance for the dfw_proximity signal (e.g. Dallas, Fort Worth, Arlington, Plano). Leave empty until the home market is set.

stop_conditions: A $0 landed-cost evaluation unit is secured and human-approved.
All credible free-unit channels are exhausted and the best fallback offer is documented.

autonomy._comment: auto_submit_applications, auto_accept_offers and auto_purchase are hard-wired OFF in code. Setting them true here has no effect; the code refuses.

approval._comment: approver is recorded on every approval row. Set it to the human's name/handle.

browser_automation._comment: allowed_domains empty = agent must ask before automating any new domain. submit_allowed is enforced OFF in code.
